editorState:
How to play:

Take notice of the sounds around you – show you are listening and point out or chat about what you can hear.

Here are some things you could say to encourage your child to listen carefully:

  • I wonder what’s making that sound...
  • That’s a loud noise!
  • I can hear a fly buzzing – can you hear it too? Can you see it?
